tools.name: hip_get_service_info
tools.description: What Have It Printed does, what it costs, what file types and sizes are accepted, and how mailing works. Needs a Bearer API key, like every tools/call (POST /v1/onboard to get one).

tools.name: hip_create_job
tools.description: Start a print-and-mail job. Returns an opaque job_handle used by every later call. Creates nothing chargeable.

tools.name: hip_get_upload_target
tools.description: Get a short-lived upload URL for the customer's document. PUT the bytes to it. File type and size limits are the same as the website.

tools.name: hip_add_text_document
tools.description: Add a letter or document whose text you wrote with the person. Have It Printed typesets it on US Letter paper in a clean serif font, in black and white, and counts its pages. Plain text only: separate paragraphs with a blank line; no images, tables or formatting. Call once per document.

tools.name: hip_get_catalog
tools.description: The options for a postcard or a letter written here: the handwriting-style fonts, the letter types, the stationery designs (with a preview picture each), the postcard sizes and fronts, and the mailing options. Read it before hip_set_postcard or hip_set_letter, and offer the person choices from it; n

tools.name: hip_set_postcard
tools.description: Write a postcard on a job from hip_create_job: its size, its front (a front from hip_get_catalog), the message on the back in a handwriting-style font, and the name it is signed with. Have It Printed checks that the message fits the card and follows the card guidelines, and returns the price and pre

tools.name: hip_set_letter
tools.description: Write a letter on a job from hip_create_job, printed in a handwriting-style font, optionally on a stationery design: the letter type, the font, the message, the greeting and sign-off, the name it is signed with, and how it is mailed (flat and tracked, a First-Class letter of up to 5 pages, or a Cert

tools.name: hip_update_job
tools.description: Set the documents, print options and US mailing recipient on a job. Price fields are rejected: the server computes all amounts.

tools.name: hip_quote
tools.description: Exact price for the job, computed by the same pricing the website checkout uses. Tax, if any, is added by Stripe at payment.

tools.name: hip_create_checkout
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout session for the job and return its URL. This does NOT take payment: the customer completes payment at that URL. Show them the quote first.

tools.name: hip_get_checkout_status
tools.description: Whether the customer has paid yet. Payment truth comes from the order record Stripe's webhook creates, never from a browser redirect.

tools.name: hip_prepare_payment
tools.description: Resolve the EXACT amount HIP will charge, before any payment authorization is obtained or spent. This does NOT charge anything. Returns subtotal_cents, tax_cents, total_cents, currency, a pricing fingerprint and the authorization types HIP accepts. Tax is calculated by Stripe from the destination, s

tools.description: Pay for the job with a delegated payment authorization, with no browser and no human step. payment_authorization must be a Stripe shared payment token (spt_...) granted to Have It Printed whose maximum is at least the total from hip_prepare_payment; HIP charges exactly that total and never more. tools.name: hip_get_order
tools.description: Status and tracking number for the paid order belonging to this job.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hip_get_service_info, hip_get_upload_target · Private data: hip_get_service_info, hip_get_upload_target, hip_add_text_document, hip_update_job, hip_get_checkout_status, hip_prepare_payment, hip_complete_payment · Public sink: hip_get_service_info, hip_get_upload_target, hip_get_checkout_status, hip_complete_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hip_get_service_info, hip_get_upload_target · Private data: hip_get_service_info, hip_get_upload_target, hip_add_text_document, hip_update_job, hip_get_checkout_status, hip_prepare_payment, hip_complete_payment · Public sink: hip_get_service_info, hip_get_upload_target, hip_get_checkout_status, hip_complete_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
